description: The magical and elaborate Stollmeyer’s Castle, also called “Killarney”, is one of seven striking mansions that make up the Magnificant Seven located around the Queen’s Park Savannah in Port of Spain and is actually the first of them to be constructed. It was built for entrepreneur Charles Stollmeyer in 1904 by Scotsman Robert Gillies who found inspiration in the Balmoral Castle of Scotland. Listed opening hours: Appointments only (8am- 4pm ). Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
